utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Yorba Linda' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the CCA operating in Orange County, currently names Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley as members — Yorba Linda was not named among current members this session. Left null rather than asserted either way.

county.notes: Yorba Linda is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Yorba Linda Building Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Yorba Linda/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Active City of Yorba Linda Business License (contractor)
Signed permit card (returned to the City after issuance)

value: Call the Building Inspection Hotline at 714-854-7411, or use the Online Building Inspection Request tool, after permit issuance

other_conditions: Contractors must be added to the SolarAPP+ program eligibility list and must have an active City of Yorba Linda Business License
SolarAPP+ has its own system-size limitations per its own eligibility tutorial, not independently quantified this session

value.name: Rooftop Solar Permit - Residential, 15kW or less
value.unit: flat fee (includes inspection and plan review); +$15/kW above 15kW
value.notes: City of Yorba Linda's own Master Fee Schedule (FY 2026-27, Building Fees, item 10a). Item 10b adds $15 per kW for capacity above 15kW.

permit_fees.notes: Confirmed via direct download and read of the City's own published Master Fee Schedule PDF, which lists a distinct 'Rooftop Solar Permit - Residential' line item separate from other building permit types.
